reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Reality falsification and deception
themes.definition: Emerging technologies worsen risks of reality falsification, disinformation and deceptive ploys.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on technology-enabled falsification of reality, disinformation or deception.
themes.exclusion: Exclude privacy or plagiarism risks absent an information-integrity element.
themes.boundary_cases: Lists of several risks can be coded here and to other themes simultaneously.

examples.quote: the worsening risks in terms of reality falsification
the spiralling effect of disinformation and ploys aimed at deception

themes.label: Invasion of personal privacy
themes.inclusion: Include passages on privacy invasion by emerging technologies.
themes.boundary_cases: Data protection in cyberspace regulation calls may also be AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

themes.label: Plagiarism disrupting education
themes.definition: Generative technologies disrupting the educational process by facilitating plagiarism.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on AI undermining education integrity, e.g., plagiarism or cheating.
themes.boundary_cases: Mixed statements on AI education benefits and cheating risks get both codes.

examples.quote: educational process disruption through the facilitation of plagiarism

themes.label: Regulating cyberspace under international law
themes.definition: Calls to unify efforts to prevent misuse and regulate technology/cyberspace based on international law, alongside cooperation and investment.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international regulation of technology misuse based on international law.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls only to encourage technological development.
themes.boundary_cases: Cyberspace regulation framed around crime may also be AI_CYBER_SECURITY.

examples.quote: we reiterate the call for unifying efforts to prevent the misuse of cyberspace and regulate this vital aspect, based on the provisions of international law

themes.label: Encouraging tech development and removing barriers
themes.definition: Encouraging scientific development, cooperation and investment, and removing barriers between countries in technology.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for cooperation, investment, or removal of cross-country barriers in technology development.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls to 'keep pace' with technology without cooperation framing are borderline; include when barriers or investment are mentioned.

examples.quote: encourage barriers between countries in this field to be removed

value.rationale: Qatar's 2023 passages balance encouraging technological development and cooperation with a list of generative-technology risks (falsification, privacy, plagiarism, disinformation) and a call to regulate misuse under international law; AI is implicit from context rather than named.
